rules.name: Suppress missing data map objects for uninstalled mods
rules.pattern: ^Object with ID .* specified in data map for registry .* doesn't exist

rules.name: Suppress Mod Menu invalid icon errors

rules.pattern: ^Ignoring unknown attribute 'forge:
